title: The Next Wave of Onchain Growth | Space and Time Co-Founder Nate Holiday at SmartCon 2025
description:
At SmartCon 2025, @SpaceandTimeDB Co-Founder Nate Holiday introduced Dreamspace, a new AI-powered app generator that enables anyone to build crypto-native applications in record time. 

View the full SmartCon playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVP9aGDn-X0R1kuQo8qLPnqlT7ThKQR2s

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi. 

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

✅ Subscribe and turn notifications on: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnjkrlqaWEBSnKZQ71gdyFA?sub_confirmation=1

Learn more about Chainlink:

Website: https://chain.link
Docs: https://docs.chain.link
Twitter: https://twitter.com/chainlink

#Chainlink #crypto #blockchain

asr.full_text: Hi everyone my name is Nate Holliday, co-founder of Space and Time and the CEO of MakeInfinite.Labs, a research of AI and Blockchain Development Company here in the United States. First, I have a question of how about those build rewards! Alright? Today I'm going to talk a little bit about creatives and the next wave of on-chain growth. Look, it's no surprise if you're in this industry that large institutions are coming on chain. Big banks are coming on chain. If you follow Chainlink at all, you're seeing all the announcements around banks and institutions that are coming on chain. space & time and make Infinite Labs are working with large banks throughout the world. The US bank, Fidelity, UBS, and others. With a tamper proof database and with oracles on chain, we now have the infrastructure to power these banks that are coming on chain. And it's great, right? What does that mean? That means that the banks are going to continue to get bigger? That more on-chain applications are going to come on that more transactions are going to come to the chain And it's going to get bigger and bigger and for the protocols like Chainlink in space and time and others that work with these banks It's going to be it's going to be great, right? But one thing that we're missing here still is mass scale individual adoption. If we look at the electric capital report, there's 27,000 developers that are building applications and protocols in web three and that's great, right. And they go and they get rewards and they get incentives to build on blockchain, like building applications that will power the future of the on-chain business. And a few killer apps have come, we see Pump, we see Polymarket, and there's a few killer apps that have mass adoption and that's really great right they go out and they get usually VC funding and they build cool applications and they go get developers on their team and they can go build really cool applications and new businesses in the future but a 16 z just we just had a research paper that came out and they estimated about 70 million people are today in the crypto industry and my question for us all is what do these 70 million people do all day what are these 70 million people do all day? What are these seventy million people creating all day? And what tools can we provide them that they can go and create businesses on chain? Today we're introducing a creative platform for the eight billion individuals throughout the world. Generate applications using AI. Deploy apps to any blockchain, monetize your business on crypto rails or not on crypto rails. Right now, anyone can build a business of the future independent of what school they went to, what education they have, what their network is, what VCs they know, whether they have a lot of friends that are developers and that if they have a creative idea, we want to unleash their potential to build something of the future. We've co-engineered this Microsoft and are launching this, and it's really exciting because for creators they can create an on-chain business from idea to an application in a matter of minutes or hours. It's easy to monetize this. It's fully deployed on the blockchain You have built in distribution through various blockchain ecosystems, through space and time and other ecosystems, you have complete built in distribution. And what about for the protocols? systems, through space and time and other ecosystems, you have complete built-in distribution. And what about for the protocols? Protocols that we're working with, love Dream Space for one reason, right? Before this, what would happen? They would run a grants program. And they'd say, hey, come submit your grant. And we'll try to pick the best projects. And we'll give you a grant to come build on our blockchain and hopefully it works and If you got the grant then you go out and you build your Protocol or your application and you'd come back in four or five six months, maybe a year maybe two years And you'd be like, here's what I built and hopefully it takes off for protocols now they can start to line incentives to applications that are product market fits for their blockchains. Come build, come show user growth, come show revenue growth and for that you'll get incentives based off of growth. Because with proof of SQL and with verified database technologies through Space and time, now we can track user growth, revenue growth, any monetary means that you can align incentives to. And this creates a flywheel effect that more apps come onto the ecosystem, whether you are a developer or not. If you have a creative idea, you can now build in crypto. So what does this mean? This means that you can now build anything on the space and time ecosystem. If you have a Defi app, if you have a social app you want to build, if you have a bakery you want to start up or a pizza joint that you want to start up. Any app that you want to build, you can build. My son, he's almost to age of where money matters to him. He wants to get a job. And he says, Dad, I need a job. I said, well go start a dog walking app. Go to all the neighbors. Go say, hey, I'll walk your dog. Sign up on this app. You can pay me. You can pay me in dollars. You can run a credit card in Stripe. You can pay me in linked tokens. You can pay me in space and time tokens. You can pay me in dollars. You can run a credit card in Stripe. You can pay me in linked tokens. You can pay me space-and-time tokens. You pay me whatever you want, right? But anyone now can start up a business if they have a creative idea. But I think we were put on this earth to create things. And far too often, society has become a consumer society. We all consume, but very few create, right? When we think about the world of on-chain finance, right, there's going to be a large institution. It's going to be wonderful. And like I've already said, I'll say it again, protocols like ChainLink and Space and Time that are servicing these large institutions and banks, it's going to be a great environment for them. But we need everyone to participate. We need everyone to create. So far, and we launched this just two months ago, we have 150,000 active or committed users. You might have followed us ... if you follow us on Twitter, you'd see that we assigned the largest institution in Indonesia, 60,000 students in higher education, and university is now running dream space AI labs to create new and unique experiences for their students. Over 32,000 applications have been developed, there's over $17 million in ecosystem revenue. And there's tier one in ecosystem blockchain over 15 partners. And so's tier-one and ecosystem blockchained over 15 partners. So today we're announcing the launch of these protocols on-chain with StreamSpace, co-engineered by Microsoft, for these ecosystems. And we're going to be building more and more across the partnerships in the industry. With that said, I want to say thank you for your time. But I want to end with this, it's time for more people to be involved. It's time that AI, the emergence of AI, with DreamSpace and Space and Time now can generate any type of application or business that you want. You can start to monetize that. You can deploy it to communities and you have built in distribution with it. And at the end of the day, right, the economy is changing. Right? We are moving to an AI economy where those that create and have ideas and can generate ideas and put them out there fast into the market, and gain mass adoption and ramp scale are gonna win. It doesn't matter if you have strong technical background or not, the future belongs to the creators, and what we're doing here is allowing anyone to participate and win in the AI economy. Thank you for your time, hope you have a great time in New York City. Thank you.
